policy_targets.coverage: Exact union of Release 153, ESR 153.0, ESR 140.13, and ESR 115.39 policy IDs from the active lifecycle catalog.
policy_targets.channel_rule: Release-only policies retain a target; channel availability remains inventory and row-state metadata.
policy_targets.deprecated_rule: A deprecated policy retains its exact target while it remains in either current channel inventory.
policy_targets.removed_rule: A policy removed from both current channel inventories must not retain a generated target.

known_preference_targets.coverage: Exact set of known managed preference IDs in the Firefox documentation inventory.
known_preference_targets.identity_rule: Preference IDs are case-sensitive and must not be lowercased, translated, slugified, or derived from visible labels.

alias_policy.rule: Editor and field aliases must resolve to a canonical policy or preference identity before documentation lookup; aliases are not additional ui-target-map keys.

contextual_action_targets.rule: Every contextual action resolves through the manifest target map; an action name is never emitted as a target-map identity or a constructed URL.

missing_artifact_policy.build_time: Target generation fails when the target topic or anchor is absent from the manifest.
missing_artifact_policy.runtime: The existing manifest resolver owns unavailable, stale, incomplete, and incompatible artifact states; row code must not construct a fallback URL.

fail_on: alias emitted as a target-map identity

execution_record.incidental_drift_fixed: Raised the deterministic per-locale search-index ceiling to 4,100,000 bytes after the M10-06 full localized-prose corpus made the 161-topic zh-CN index 3,980,853 bytes; all other search budgets remain unchanged.
